name: regex-check-mcp
description: Tests regular expressions on the real engines, in process: JavaScript (V8), Python (CPython's re, via Pyodide), PCRE2 10.48 (PHP, grep -P, nginx) and RE2 (Go, BigQuery). Each engine gives its own verdict: compile errors with position, every match with its groups and named groups, and the result of a replacement; differences between engines are listed. Finds catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) with an attack string and confirms it by timing the backtracking engines. Offline, no key.

dependencyReasons.pyodide: CPython compiled to WebAssembly: Python patterns run on Python's own re module, so matches, groups and errors are exactly what Python gives.
dependencyReasons.pcre2-wasm: PCRE2 10.48 compiled to WebAssembly (MIT), the engine behind PHP's preg functions, grep -P and nginx, with match limits against runaway backtracking.
dependencyReasons.re2-wasm: Google's RE2 compiled to WebAssembly (Apache-2.0): the linear-time engine whose syntax Go's regexp and BigQuery accept.
dependencyReasons.recheck: A ReDoS checker (MIT) that proves catastrophic backtracking by building an attack string, instead of guessing from the pattern's shape.
